text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — NexThera QBR prep. They hit a token surge last week and flagged unexpected spend. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Can @Eli (FinOps) and @Jonah (Solutions) help triage spend forecast + short-term guardrails?

Eli (FinOps): Yup, saw the spike in billed tokens. Pulling 7d and 30d by model+route now. Initial hunch: embeddings job misfire + some long-chat sessions.

Jonah (Solutions): We shipped a batch embedding job that should be async. Looks like a cron doubled up and fired live requests. I can push a fix to throttle retriggers.

Sasha (PM): Customer reported ~2.3x expected spend — they're concerned about runway ahead of renewal. We should prepare: updated forecast, mitigations (rate limits/quotas), and a concise one-pager for the QBR.

Maya (CS): Immediate asks (48h):
- Set a soft budget alert at 60% of their monthly commit
- Apply temporary rate limit on /v1/embeddings route (100r/min) and 50r/min for long-context chat sessions
- Get a 7d/30d forecast by EOD tomorrow and a short root-cause note for QBR
- Collect 5 representative prompts/examples that caused the spike for engineering review

Eli (FinOps): I'll create the alert. Proposed alert rule (console):
```
when sum(token_cost) over 1d > 0.6 * monthly_commit then notify(#customer-success;threshold=60%)
```
I'll also attach per-route breakdown.

Jonah (Solutions): For throttle, we can add a routing policy override for this customer:
- embeddings: concurrency=4, rps=1.6 (approx 100r/min)
- chat-long: max_seq=1024 cap and rps=0.8
I'll stage config in staging and roll in 15m.

Tariq (Eng-oncall): On it. Will open a short-lived policy and guard for NexThera. Also adding a quick KV cache for repeated prefixes to reduce regen.

Maya (CS): Helpful — also let's add a temporary billing note to customer so they don't get surprised during QBR. Jonah, can you summarize the fix in 3 bullets for the one-pager?

Jonah (Solutions): Sure — draft: 1) root cause: duplicate batch job firing embedding requests; 2) mitigation: rate-limit + disable duplicate cron; 3) long-term: add safe-guard in the embed pipeline + alert on embedding anomalies.

Eli (FinOps): Alert created: billing-bot notified. Attaching preliminary forecast (quick numbers):
- trailing 7d avg burn: 1.9M tokens/day
- projected month if unchanged: ~57M tokens (~$2.3k)
- with throttle & fix: projected month: ~18M tokens (~$720)

billing-bot: Budget alert (NexThera) created at 60% threshold. Notification sent to #customer-success and email to custops@nexthera.com.

ops-alerts: Routing policy applied: nexthera-embeds-throttle (active).

Sasha (PM): Great. For the QBR deck, we'll need: the 1-page root-cause, the 30/90 day forecast, and the proposed SLA/guardrail options (soft alerts, per-route quotas, commit adjustments). Can someone owner the deck slide?

Maya (CS): I'll own the slide. Jonah — send your 3-bullet summary + any sample prompts to me by EOD. Eli — finalize the numbers and attach the raw export. Tariq — keep the throttle in place until we confirm the cron fix.

Tariq (Eng-oncall): Cron disabled, embedding job rerun with corrected schedule. Observability shows embed requests down ~92% vs peak. I'll leave the policy active and tag it for review in 72h.

Eli (FinOps): Updated forecast attached to thread (CSV link). I'll also add a recurring watch for 3 days.

Jonah (Solutions): Sample prompts posted to the shared drive: link. Two of them were long, repeated contexts that re-triggered embedding refresh.

Maya (CS): Awesome. Next steps recap:
- Maya: QBR slide (includes 3 bullets + forecast)
- Eli: final forecast + export + watch
- Jonah: sample prompts + short root cause
- Tariq: keep throttle for 72h, then re-evaluate
- Billing-bot/ops-alerts: keep alerts live and escalate if >75%

Sasha (PM): Thanks team — this should prevent another nasty bill before renewal and gives the account a clear remediation story for the QBR.

Maya (CS): I'll message the NexThera CSM with the plan and a small apology note. Back to everyone — please ping if you hit any blockers. :thumbsup:
